DeckFlip — AI Presentation Editor TypeScript / React / Vite / Serverless / Supabase / Anthropic Claude + OpenAI
Live GitHub

Full-stack web app that generates self-contained HTML/CSS/JS slide decks from a prompt, then lets you refine them by clicking, dragging, and re-prompting — every AI edit forced through a validation gate so the model never emits raw markup.

Objective: Make AI-generated presentations editable without touching code. A multi-pass LLM pipeline (plan -> foundation -> parallel per-slide generation -> deterministic assembly -> lint-gated QA repair) produces decks, and an in-browser editor lets users restyle them live while the AI is constrained to a safe, validated JSON patch/action vocabulary.

Impact: Deployed at deckflip.net. ~224-file TypeScript codebase with a provider fallback chain (Anthropic Opus -> OpenAI -> deterministic mock) so generation never hard-fails, a ~3,000-line sandboxed in-iframe DOM editor that preserves each deck's own CSS/JS/3D animations, a cross-device live audience layer over Supabase Realtime with row-level-security event replay, a multilingual UI (KO/EN/JA/ZH), and Vitest + Playwright test suites.

TypeScript, React, Vite, LLM / AI, Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI API, Serverless, Supabase / Postgres, Realtime, Vitest / Playwright,

Live: https://deckflip.net

GitHub: https://github.com/jwhwang91/DeckFlip

DecisionCanvas Studio — Visual Multi-Agent AI Workflow Builder Next.js / React Flow / FastAPI / Python / Pydantic / Server-Sent Events / Docker
GitHub

Full-stack studio for composing auditable multi-agent AI decision pipelines as typed node graphs, with a live-streaming execution engine and deterministic safety gates that run after the AI decision and cannot be bypassed by an agent.

Objective: Let non-trivial AI decision systems be built visually and audited. A React Flow canvas wires typed input/output ports into a graph, a compiler validates port compatibility and detects control cycles (Kahn topological sort), and an async engine executes the graph while streaming node/edge state to the UI over Server-Sent Events.

Impact: Working prototype (v0.3.0). ~832-line async execution engine, a pluggable LLM router across OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic / Ollama with automatic offline mock fallback, an AI-independent safety subsystem (gate chain + regime classifier) evaluated after the model decision, ~20 FastAPI REST endpoints plus SSE streaming, a YAML-manifest package system, and 80 pytest tests.

Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React Flow, LLM / AI, Multi-Provider LLM, Server-Sent Events, Graph Algorithms, Pydantic, Docker / pytest,

GitHub: https://github.com/jwhwang91/decisioncanvas-studio
